policy.no_single_solution: Multiple methods may be registered and run in parallel; selection is evidence- and goal-dependent.
policy.experimental_allowed: Experimental methods are first-class but must declare maturity, assumptions, uncertainty and controls.
policy.reconstruction_boundary: Reconstructed/synthetic values never become original observations.
policy.provenance: Every derived result retains source identity, time support, parameters, method/package version and uncertainty where applicable.
policy.contradiction: Disagreement among methods is preserved and may itself be evidence.

methods.principle: Estimate coherent delayed copies of a directly observed acoustic event and retain delay, correlation, gain and path-class evidence without converting excess-path timing into source range.

The propagation response is sufficiently stable within the local estimation window.
methods.allowed_claim: measured coherent excess-path timing and transfer evidence within the declared estimator envelope

assumptions: Adjacent windows contain enough correlated support to associate path trajectories.

methods.name: Motion-induced acoustic path coherence
methods.principle: Combine measured delay-trajectory smoothness, path-time-warp/Doppler consistency, spectral-transfer stability, reconstruction agreement and physical compatibility into a bounded coherence factor.
assumptions: Input observations already carry measured delay and reconstruction/spectral/physics evidence.
failure_modes: resetting state at a shard boundary
methods.allowed_claim: bounded compatibility/coherence evidence for one measured acoustic path trajectory
methods.forbidden_claim: Do not interpret coherence as source probability, source identity, or video-derived acoustic score.

methods.name: Acoustic multipath physics-compatibility evidence
methods.principle: Convert measured excess-path delay and delay rate into propagation quantities and score only bounded causality, motion plausibility and transfer stability.
assumptions: Propagation speed/profile is declared for the assessed medium.
methods.allowed_claim: physics-compatibility evidence for a measured excess-path trajectory
methods.forbidden_claim: Do not call excess-path rate reflector velocity and do not convert compatibility into source-range probability.

methods.name: Trajectory-conditioned multipath virtual-microphone reconstruction
methods.principle: Treat stable coherent reflected paths as delay-corrected secondary observations and combine them conservatively with the direct signal, dynamically aligning moving paths and suppressing unstable transfer.
assumptions: Selected reflected paths are coherent secondary observations of the same source event.
Delay/polarity estimates are sufficiently accurate for combination.
methods.allowed_claim: derived reconstruction candidate assembled from source-supported direct and coherent delayed observations
methods.forbidden_claim: Do not call the reconstruction an original waveform, recovered transcript truth, source range, or independent corroboration of the path estimator that selected its inputs.

methods.name: Complementary alternating spectral-bucket views
methods.principle: Partition one captured waveform into complementary alternating frequency buckets using declared slot width, ceiling and offset. Odd plus even reconstructs the selected passband; the partition is a deterministic listening/measurement view, not source separation.
assumptions: The declared FFT/window/bucket geometry is appropriate for the research question.
failure_modes: mistaking one-waveform partition for multiple sources
methods.allowed_claim: deterministic complementary frequency-bucket views and their measured recombination residual under the declared transform
methods.forbidden_claim: Do not claim that odd/even views reveal independent sources, speakers, emitters, intent, or a historical multiplexing process.

methods.name: Alternating-bucket phase sensitivity sweep
methods.principle: Repeat the complementary alternating-bucket partition at several bucket-origin offsets and measure energy fractions plus exact passband-reconstruction error, exposing conclusions that depend on arbitrary bucket boundaries.
assumptions: Offsets are declared before interpretation and remain within the slot width.
failure_modes: energy fraction interpreted as speech probability
methods.allowed_claim: measured sensitivity of alternating-bucket energy allocation to declared frequency-origin offsets
methods.forbidden_claim: Do not classify speech, count sources, or select the most persuasive offset as evidential truth.

methods.name: Bounded alternating-bucket preference listening view
methods.principle: Attenuate the non-preferred complementary bucket set by a declared relative dB amount and apply a shared peak-safe scale, creating an audition aid without adding spectral information.
assumptions: Preference is a listening transform, not evidence weighting.
failure_modes: changed intelligibility mistaken for recovered content
methods.allowed_claim: derived peak-safe listening view produced by declared relative attenuation of complementary buckets
methods.forbidden_claim: Do not call increased audibility new acoustic information, recovered speech truth, or an independent source.

methods.name: Externally-seeded harmonic observation
methods.principle: Evaluate local expected-harmonic peak support only after an external voiced-f0 hypothesis is supplied; report peak-to-local-floor measurements without inferring a new fundamental or source identity from each narrow band.
assumptions: The supplied f0 is independently justified for the evaluated voiced interval.
methods.allowed_claim: local support or absence for expected harmonics under an externally supplied voiced-f0 hypothesis
methods.forbidden_claim: Do not infer speaker identity, multiple sources, digital multiplexing, or intentional staging from missing or present harmonics alone.

methods.name: Known-input alternating spectral interleave positive control
methods.principle: Construct a controlled two-input spectral weave with known bucket assignment, then verify that the same alternating-bucket transform recovers the known assigned components. Unknown field material is never used as positive truth.
assumptions: Both control inputs share declared sample/channel geometry.
failure_modes: claim transfer from synthetic control to unknown recording
methods.allowed_claim: the declared alternating-band transform recovers its known synthetic bucket assignments within measured numerical tolerance
methods.forbidden_claim: Do not treat success on the constructed control as proof that an unknown recording was created by the same process.
